comparison.performance_metrics_withheld: Log-loss and AUC were not computed: the sample contains 9 goals, below the 20 this project requires before reporting a predictive-performance comparison. With this few positive cases the difference between two models' scores is dominated by which individual shots happened to go in, so any such number would invite a conclusion the data cannot support. The shot-by-shot disagreements from find_biggest_disagreements() are the usable output here.
